gary_2026_11_19_house_of_ideas_conferenc.title: House Of Ideas - Conference Built Around Your Business
gary_2026_11_19_house_of_ideas_conferenc.label: Startup / Business
gary_2026_11_19_house_of_ideas_conferenc.summary: Gary's Guide: Choose the conversations, experts & connections your business needs right now at WE NYC's fall conference. Celebrate Women's Entrepreneurship Day with us! Come over to WE NYC: House of Ideas, a different kind of entrepreneurship conference-one designed to meet you wherever you are in building your business. No sitting through hours of programming waiting for the one session that applies to you. Instead, consider this a choose-your-own-adventure for your business. Come together for big ideas & candid founder conversations. Then choose where you need to go next: pull up a chair for a hands-on workshop, get practical answers during office hours, meet a WE NYC mentor, update your headshot, or simply find another entrepreneur who understands exactly what you're working through. Across the House, you can: Hear candid conversations & big ideas about what it actually takes to build a business that works. Roll up your sleeves in smaller, hands-on workshops designed to help you work through real business challenges. Get closer to the expertise. Ask questions about money, marketing, mentorship & growing your business-and connect directly with people who can help. Meet other NYC entrepreneurs, trade ideas & make the kind of connections that can lead somewhere. Plus: complimentary professional headshots, bites, drinks & plenty of room for the hallway conversations you didn't know you needed. Because you don't need every answer tonight. You might just need the right answer, introduction, idea or person to help you take your next step. Doors open at 5:00 PM, giving you time to settle in & connect before programming begins at 5:30 PM. Choose where you need to be. Let the rest of the House surprise you. Presented by WE NYC About the Organizers Women Entrepreneurs NYC (WE NYC) is an initiative of the NYC Department of Small Business Services (SBS) that is dedicated to helping women start & grow their businesses. If you have questions about this WE NYC Program or would like additional information about WE NYC, please e-mail wenyc@sbs.nyc.gov or visit we.nyc. Photographic Consent Disclaimer By registering to attend, you consent to be photographed, filmed, and/or otherwise recorded. Your registration constitutes your consent to such photography, filming, and/or recording & to any use, in any & all media throughout the universe in perpetuity, of your appearance, voice, & name for any purpose whatsoever in connection with this event. You understand that all photography, filming, and/or recording will be done in reliance on this consent given by you registering to attend this event. If you do not agree to the foregoing, please do not register to attend this event. Disclaimer WE NYC programs are open to all New Yorkers. gary_2026_11_20_pms_unfiltered_where_ai_.summary: Gary's Guide: Whos your sounding board? Because most PMs dont have one. Product Managers are surrounded by advice but short on access. LinkedIn is full of voices with 100,000+ followers, yet getting a real answer from any one is rare.Come join us in an intimate, curated coffee walk where product managers trade notes on the questions that rarely make it onto a roadmap. No pitches, no panels, no cold networking. Only real conversations.What well talk aboutHow AI is changing day-to-day PM work, & why the answer differs between a regulated enterprise & a startup.What peers in the role are actually doing, so you can tell whether your pace is right.What it takes to make the next move, from one role or company to the next.What to expect:Two miles. Two conversations.The first is by design: we pair you with a PM from a different domain & stage. The second is by chance: a chit draw puts you next to someone you wouldnt have picked.The host opens with her own career transition & we finish with an ask-and-offer round. Bring one question & one thing you can give, & everyone leaves with both covered.An opt-in LinkedIn group follows, so phones stay in pockets during the walk.If this sounds like you, don't forget to RSVP. This event is intimate by choice. Every request is reviewed, & approved guests get the exact meeting point.See you there!

gary_2026_12_01_pm_2_0_product_mgmt_in_a.title: PM 2.0 - Product Mgmt In Age Of AI
gary_2026_12_01_pm_2_0_product_mgmt_in_a.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_12_01_pm_2_0_product_mgmt_in_a.summary: Gary's Guide: Product Management in the Age of AIIf AI can write the PRD, summarize customer feedback, research competitors, & build prototypes what is the Product Managers job now?Join Pioneering Minds AI for an interactive workshop on how product management is changing in the age of AI, & what makes a great PM today.Well bring together both experienced old-school PMs & a new generation of AI-native PMs to compare how the role has evolved, which skills still matter, & what students should focus on if they want to work in product.What Well DiscussWhat great PMs looked like before AIWhich traditional PM skills still matterWhich parts of the job AI is already changingHow PMs can use AI for research, prototyping, prioritization, & product discoveryWhether PMs need to become more technicalWhy judgment, taste, communication, & problem selection may matter more than everWhat companies may look for in the next generation of PMsWell also discuss a bigger question:When AI makes execution easier, does the PMs real value shift from managing the process to deciding what should be built in the first place?No previous PM or technical experience is required. The session is designed primarily for students, aspiring PMs, & early-career professionals interested in product, startups, & AI.Hackathon PreviewThis workshop takes place the day before the Pioneering Minds AI Hackathon & will also serve as a warm-up for participants.Well share an early look at the hackathon tracks:Critical Thinking & LearningAI for Product Management WorkflowsLegal Tech WorkflowsFintech & Insurtech WorkflowsWell also provide guidance on choosing a strong problem, designing an AI-native workflow, & what judges will be looking for.If youre joining the hackathon, this is your chance to get a head start.About Pioneering Minds AIAt pioneeringminds.ai, we grow AI-native pioneers who build, deploy, & govern AI responsibly while keeping humans in the front seat.

gary_2026_12_02_ai_build_lab_for_founder.title: AI Build Lab For Founders - Launch & Read The Signal
gary_2026_12_02_ai_build_lab_for_founder.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_12_02_ai_build_lab_for_founder.summary: Gary's Guide: AI Build Lab for Founders Series Take your idea from concept to launch in a series of interactive sessions. Leverage AI tools to build a live product, put it in front of users, & leave with honest feedback, concrete next steps, & the tools to keep going - no coding background required. Session 3: Launch Acquire users, analyze the data, & make the call. Compare your live user engagement against pre-set targets, locate your audience's online channels, & run live outreach during the session. Evaluate the evidence to decide whether to persevere, pivot, or pause, & map out your next test. Who it is for Current NYU students, Alumni, & Faculty Coders & non-coders are welcome. Anyone who wants to explore ideas, is curious about entrepreneurship, or has started building. Deliverables for Session 3: Launch Get to your first users, a plan to market, or a path to pivot An evidence scorecard for your product, or MVP A decision: continue, change, or stop A 14-day plan for the next test Full series highlights Hands-on from start to finish. Every session ends with something real in hand, not just notes. Real customers, not guesses. Founders talk to 5 to 10 potential users & put a working product in front of them. Two tracks. No-code founders build with tools like Lovable, Replit, v0, & Bolt. Founders who code use Claude Code or Cursor. Honest checks built in. Founders open & verify every source, set their success target before the results come in, & have a second tool test every build. A live product with a real ask. Each product goes live with a waitlist, pre-order, or booking option. Demo day. The series ends with founders presenting to guest founders & investors. Tools they keep. Every founder leaves with the full Leverage kit & their own working setup. What founders walk away with A tested idea. Assumptions checked against real conversations & real data. A live product MVP. Reviewed, tested, & in front of first users, or a clear & cheap "no." A decision & a plan. Continue, change, or stop, backed by evidence, with the next 14-day test written out. Their own working toolkit. Research, idea testing, building & review tools, set up & ready to use. The Leverage kit. Every prompt & tool used in the series. Entrepreneurship mindset. Check the sources. Set the target first. Never let the builder grade its own work. A cohort. A group of founders who built alongside them.

jc_culture_10003580_2026_12_09_hamilton_.place: Hamilton Park, 9 McWilliams Pl., Jersey City, NJ
jc_culture_10003580_2026_12_09_hamilton_.summary: Join us at the Hamilton Park Farmers Market, your midweek destination for fresh, local, and thoughtfully crafted food and goods. Each week, we’re proud to feature farm-fresh produce from Stony Hill Farm alongside a curated selection of specialty vendors. Browse a variety of offerings including our long time vendor Pickles and Olives, fresh seafood from Scale Fish Market, and prepared foods perfect for dinner. You can also find baked goods, candles, personal care products, and more. You can even take advantage of convenient services like on-site knife sharpening while you shop. On the first and second Wednesdays of each month, enjoy live entertainment that adds to the vibrant, community atmosphere of the market. Whether you’re shopping for the week, grabbing a bite, or simply enjoying the park, the Hamilton Park Farmers Market is a welcoming space to connect with local vendors and neighbors.
